item.title: Kalamazoo inmate sues after being left in hot transport van
item.description: One of seven Kalamazoo County Jail inmates who were left unattended in a transport van for nearly two hours in May 2025 has filed a lawsuit against the county and two members of the sheriff’s office saying the treatment amounted to torture.

item.title: Grand Rapids’ Auburn Hills neighborhood added to National Register of Historic Places
item.description: GRAND RAPIDS, Mich. (WOOD) — After several years of work, Grand Rapids’ Auburn Hills neighborhood has been added to the National Register of Historic Places. The Michigan Economic Development Corporation announced Friday that the neighborhood was added to the register along with 12 other properties across the state. item.title: Exploding trees: Fact or fiction? An expert weighs in
item.description: Exploding trees may be taking over your social media feed, but a local gardening expert says you are unlikely to see them in your own backyard.

item.title: Flying soon? This mistake could cost you $45 under a new TSA policy
item.description: The new policy will help cover the cost of verifying the identity of travelers with insufficient ID, the TSA says.

item.title: Grand Rapids pastors lay out three-point plan to combat violence
item.description: Pastors from congregations across Grand Rapids are coming together with a shared mission of stopping violence.

item.title: What to do — and not do — about ice dams
item.description: Roofing companies have been busy fielding calls and making repairs as the winter weather has led to big icicles and ice dams on many West Michigan homes.

item.title: 'We have not forgotten Damon': GRPD asks for help to solve 2020 murder
item.description: It's been more than five years since a 43-year-old man was shot and killed in Grand Rapids' Creston neighborhood. On Friday, police again asked for the community's help to identify the suspect.

item.title: AG's Office gives Gotion 30 days to pay back $23.7 million
item.description: The Michigan Attorney General's Office has told battery manufacturer Gotion it has 30 days to pay back tens of millions of dollars in state incentives after a plan to build a plant near Big Rapids seems to have fallen apart.

item.title: West Michigan businesses shut down to protest immigration policies
item.description: Many businesses across the country, including some in West Michigan, closed Friday as part of an economic blackout protest against President Donald Trump's latest immigration crackdown.
